items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: No. Had Jack Jackson, was on the piano.

ctx.x: They had everything, you know. They had little scrap bands around there, but Black and Tan was the whole go (Unintelligible). And they had a good band.
Uh-huh. Any New Orleans players in that band?
No. Had Jack Jackson, was on the piano. He was a friend of Louis.
